description: Review and fix any bugs in the Elementor plugin widget PHP files. Check all 12 widget files for common issues: missing closing tags, inconsistent control names vs render output field access, controls defined but not rendered, incorrect preset field name mapping, unclosed HTML elements in render() output, missing esc_* sanitization, broken JavaScript in inline scripts.
steps: Review /projects/sandbox/test/vira-sections-plugin/widgets/class-hero.php: Check that all controls defined in register_controls() are properly accessed in render() via $s['field_name']. Check the preset field names in class-presets.php (e.g. 'stats' repeater uses 'stat_value'/'stat_suffix'/'stat_label' in presets but the widget render might use 'value'/'suffix'/'label'). Fix any mismatches between preset data field names and widget control field names.
Review /projects/sandbox/test/vira-sections-plugin/widgets/class-services-bento.php: Verify render() output matches all controls. Check card_icon rendering works with Icons_Manager.
Review /projects/sandbox/test/vira-sections-plugin/widgets/class-tabs.php: Verify tabs repeater field names match between controls and render.

Review /projects/sandbox/test/vira-sections-plugin/widgets/class-process-timeline.php: Verify steps repeater field names in presets (step_number, step_title, step_duration, panel_title, panel_description, panel_deliverables) match the control field names in the widget.
Review /projects/sandbox/test/vira-sections-plugin/widgets/class-pricing.php: Verify plans repeater fields match between presets and widget controls.
Review /projects/sandbox/test/vira-sections-plugin/widgets/class-testimonials-slider.php: Check that preset field names (avatar_text, quote, name, company, badge_text) match widget control fields.
Review /projects/sandbox/test/vira-sections-plugin/widgets/class-faq-search.php: Verify items repeater fields (question, answer, item_categories) match controls.

Review /projects/sandbox/test/vira-sections-plugin/widgets/class-cta-form.php: Check that preset fields (badge_text, heading, description, features, select_options, submit_text) match widget controls. Verify the features repeater uses 'feat_text' vs preset's 'feature_text'.
Review /projects/sandbox/test/vira-sections-plugin/widgets/class-trust-strip.php: Verify logo repeater field names match.
Review /projects/sandbox/test/vira-sections-plugin/widgets/class-curriculum.php: Verify module repeater fields match presets.
Review /projects/sandbox/test/vira-sections-plugin/assets/js/preset-handler.js: Check for issues with event binding, duplicate handler prevention, and proper settings update triggering.

Fix any field name mismatches found. The most likely bugs are: 1) CTA form preset uses 'feature_text' but widget repeater field is 'feat_text'. 2) Hero preset uses 'stat_value'/'stat_suffix'/'stat_label' but widget repeater uses 'value'/'suffix'/'label'. 3) Marquee preset uses 'text' field but widget uses 'item' field. Fix either the presets or the widgets to make them consistent.
Review the preset-handler.js to ensure it properly handles repeater-type fields (arrays of objects) when applying presets, since Elementor repeaters need special treatment.
acceptance_criteria: All widget control field names in register_controls() are consistent with the keys used in the preset data from class-presets.php
All render() methods properly access settings that exist in controls
No orphaned controls (defined but never rendered) remain
No HTML tags left unclosed in render() output
JavaScript in inline scripts has no syntax errors
preset-handler.js correctly applies presets including repeater fields
verification: Grep for field name mismatches between preset data keys and widget control IDs
Verify each preset method's repeater data uses the same keys as the widget's repeater controls
findings:
Fixed 7 categories of preset key mismatches in class-presets.php:

1. HERO WIDGET - Stats repeater: Changed 'stat_value' → 'value', 'stat_suffix' → 'suffix', 'stat_label' → 'label' (affected all 5 page presets × 3 stats each = 15 fields)
2. HERO WIDGET - Marquee repeater: Changed 'text' → 'item' (affected all 5 page presets × ~6 items each = ~30 fields)
3. CTA FORM WIDGET - Features repeater: Changed 'feature_text' → 'feat_text' (affected all 5 page presets × ~3-4 items = ~18 fields)
4. CTA FORM WIDGET - Select options repeater: Changed 'option_text' → 'opt_text' (affected all 5 page presets × ~5 items = ~25 fields)
5. STATS COUNTER WIDGET - Counters repeater: Changed 'counter_value' → 'number_value', 'counter_suffix' → 'suffix', 'counter_label' → 'label' (affected 2 page presets × 4 counters = 8 fields)
6. PROCESS TIMELINE WIDGET - Steps repeater: Changed 'panel_deliverables' → 'panel_features' (affected 4 page presets × 4-5 steps = ~18 fields)
7. SERVICES BENTO WIDGET - Homepage cards: Changed 'card_style' => 'dark' → 'card_is_dark' => 'yes' (1 field)
8. TECH STACK WIDGET - Tabs: Changed 'tab_title' → 'tab_label', removed invalid 'tab_items' field, added proper 'panel_title' and 'panel_subtitle' fields instead (4 tabs)
9. CURRICULUM WIDGET - Modules: Changed 'chips' (combined string) → split into 'sessions_count', 'duration', 'level' fields to match widget control IDs (8 modules)

Also verified: Testimonials slider (items: avatar_text, quote, name, company, badge_text ✓), FAQ search (items: question, answer, item_categories ✓; categories: cat_slug, cat_label ✓), Pricing (plans: plan_name, plan_desc, plan_price_monthly, plan_price_yearly, plan_period, plan_features, plan_featured, plan_badge, plan_cta_text ✓), Tabs (tabs: tab_title, tab_subtitle, panel_title, panel_description, panel_features ✓), Trust Strip (logos: logo_text ✓) - all correct.

preset-handler.js reviewed: Uses settings.set(key, data[key]) approach which works for both simple fields and repeater arrays in Elementor. The implementation is correct.
